answers.question: What is Kershell TI?
answers.answer: Kershell TI is a software engineering studio founded by two senior developers with 7+ years building systems in banking, logistics, and critical operations. We use AI as an internal accelerator — not as a marketing claim — to deliver enterprise-grade software at startup speed.

answers.question: What type of company is Kershell TI for?
answers.answer: Companies that have a real technical problem to solve — whether it's their first SaaS product, an internal platform that needs AI, or a legacy system that needs modernizing. We work with mid-market companies, innovation teams, operations leaders, and B2B founders.

answers.question: How is Kershell TI different from a traditional agency?
answers.answer: We don't sell screens — we build operating products. No account managers, no project coordinators, no layers. Two senior engineers making direct technical decisions, with AI accelerating the execution, not replacing the judgment.

process.title: From idea to impact.
process.subtitle: We understand your operation, design the system and build with purpose. The same team, from start to finish.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: We map your domain, data flows, users, technical constraints, and risks in 2-3 sessions. Before writing code, we understand what the system must decide — not just what it must display.

steps.title: Architecture
steps.description: We define the data model, integrations, permissions, AI modules, and deployment strategy. You get a technical blueprint you can evaluate, challenge, and own.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: We build in modular iterations with AI as an internal accelerator. Every module goes through senior review on architecture, code quality, UX, and security before shipping.

steps.title: Deploy & Scale
steps.description: We deploy, measure, document, and hand over a system ready to evolve. New business rules, new data sources, new users — the architecture supports it without starting over.
